closing.geometry: Desktop stage 100svh, min-height 660px; perspective 1500px. Footer min-height min(880px,100svh), compact min(680px,100svh).
closing.accessibility: Static reduced-motion/no-JavaScript composition and native links; no WebGL dependency. Closing focus 3px solid #88d9ee / 5px offset; footer focus 2px / 5px, wordmark 6px offset.
closing.productTruth: Existing genuine StockX-edit photographs and provenance are reused. Nike Air Max Plus Celestine Blue is a complete photo, with adidas Samba OG, New Balance 9060 and ASICS GEL-1130 as supporting prints. No new raster, renderer or dependency.
closing.commerce: Collection/search remain native links. Configured footer menu, shop policies, enabled payment icons and back-to-top are retained; no fabricated social, support or legal links.
closing.evidence: Accepted independent finish review: ship, no material findings; 1440x900, 1366x768, 390x844 and 375x667, forward/reverse source and actual captures.

dos: Do retain the blue-and-white subject and the pale-blue, ice and ocean environments.
Do preserve local Archivo width and weight variation, readable prose and compact-screen overrides.
Do connect every material-study anchor and caption to the corresponding visible perspective.
Do preserve native Shopify product, variant, availability, search, collection and cart behavior.
Do keep reference credits, model-study disclosures and shipping-asset provenance intact.
Do keep content and navigation usable with reduced motion, failed WebGL and no JavaScript.
narrative.overview:
STRYDE combines a blue-and-white sneaker study with monumental editorial typography. Pale sky and ice fields give the subject room; ocean chapters concentrate attention. A locally bundled variable Archivo family shifts width and weight between expressive headlines and precise captions.

Depth comes from the sneaker, its light and its changing perspective. Useful HTML copy, annotation ledgers, material-study anchors and a chapter index keep the experience legible. The motion follows a continuous subject through product chapters, including a real-light Brand studio; credited photography remains a separate reference plate.

rules.body: Supporting colors frame the blue-and-white sneaker; preserve the clear distinction between pale study fields and ocean chapters.
rules.name: The Subject Color Rule

rules.body: Scale prose as well as display type on wide screens; retain the explicit compact-screen overrides instead of shrinking a desktop composition uniformly.
rules.name: The Readable Scale Rule

rules.body: The fixed canvas owns the active disclosed study, with separate clipped views for both visible chapter windows at a handoff. Keep credited reference photography separate and retain the image fallback until the scene successfully owns its host.
rules.name: The One Subject Rule

donts: Don't replace the continuous product subject with repeated flat-picture reveals in animated product chapters.
Don't let the 3D overlay capture pointer events or obscure essential reading and action zones.
Don't use reference studies as purchasable inventory or evidence of performance claims.
Don't apply homepage-only type sizes or stage geometry to native commerce routes.
Don't add long empty pinned intervals or a blank closing tail.
keyCharacteristics: Blue-and-white product identity, with ice, ocean and concentrated cobalt.
Monumental variable typography paired with readable editorial copy.
One continuous 3D subject, anchored by HTML navigation and disclosures.
Hairline ledgers, square media and restrained action corners.
